title: On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation
title_zh: 设备端智能体操作缓存——以分类器为中心的自然语言到动作生成

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise ( 100 + 100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, creates data privacy concerns, and, given the costs of running these models, can rapidly escalate expenses associated with supporting agentic features.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体人工智能正越来越多地嵌入软件应用中，为各项功能提供自然语言接口。 在大多数情况下，这些智能体由企业级（1000+1000亿参数）或前沿级大型语言模型驱动，这些模型需要大量计算资源来运行，并依赖云端托管推理，以完成将自然语言输入转化为可执行软件操作的任务。 这种对云端托管推理的依赖不仅会在大型语言模型的推理时间之上引入显著的网络延迟，还会引发数据隐私问题；此外，考虑到运行这些模型的成本，支持智能体功能的相关费用可能迅速飙升。

paragraphs.en: This paper introduces a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches . These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring classes of actions completely on-device – reducing latency, enhancing privacy, and lowering operational costs. We show that for a classic NL-to-Formula task, generating Excel Formula in response to user requests, this approach reduces total inference cost by 56 % 56\% when compared to cloud-only model-routing based inference and, on cache hits, reduces the latency to response latency by 5 × 5\times .
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过设备端操作缓存，将自然语言到动作的问题从生成性问题转化为以分类为核心的问题。 这些缓存使智能体系统能够完全在设备端处理频繁出现的动作类别——从而减少延迟、增强隐私并降低运营成本。 我们证明，对于经典的自然语言到公式任务（即根据用户请求生成 Excel 公式），与仅基于云端模型路由的推理方法相比，该方法可将总推理成本降低 56%（56\%）；在缓存命中的情况下，响应延迟还可减少 5 倍（5\times）。

paragraphs.en: Adding natural language interfaces to software applications has, driven by the capabilities of large language models, become increasingly common. The most direct approach to providing natural language interfaces is through the use of agentic AI, powered by enterprise ( 100 + 100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that are run via cloud-hosted inference. While effective, this approach can rapidly escalate cost-of-goods (COGS) and the combination of network latency and time-to-first token can lead to poor user experience.
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型能力的推动下，为软件应用添加自然语言接口已变得越来越普遍。 提供自然语言接口最直接的方法是使用智能体式人工智能，其动力来自通过云端托管推理运行的企业级（1000+1000亿参数）或前沿级大型语言模型。 尽管这种方法有效，但它可能迅速推高商品成本（COGS），而网络延迟与首个词元生成时间相结合，也可能导致糟糕的用户体验。

paragraphs.en: A first general step in addressing these cost challenges is the introduction of model-routing mechanisms that can intelligently select a suitable model for a query based on its estimated complexity and resource requirements. However, this does little to improve the latency issue, and as the routing decisions are designed to error on the side of selecting more capable models the costs remain high.
paragraphs.zh: 应对这些成本挑战的第一步，通常是引入模型路由机制，该机制能够根据查询的预估复杂度和资源需求，智能地选择适合该查询的模型。 然而，这种方法对改善延迟问题几乎无济于事；而且由于路由决策的设计倾向于选择能力更强的模型，因此成本仍然很高。

paragraphs.en: However, when when we look at the overall workflow for handling natural language queries in a specific application, such as spreadsheets, it is quickly apparent that queries follow a pareto style distribution, and typically involve a relatively small set of recurring operations, suggesting the potential for developing a classifier to identify these recurring operations and enable semantic operation caching to improve efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当我们审视特定应用程序（例如电子表格）中处理自然语言查询的整体工作流程时，很快就会发现，这些查询遵循帕累托式分布，通常只涉及一组相对较少的重复操作。这表明，开发一种分类器来识别这些重复操作并实现语义操作缓存以提升效率是可行的。

paragraphs.en: Taking inspiration from traditional caching mechanisms, which are proven to be a highly effective strategy for improving performance and reducing costs on workloads with these features, this paper proposes the introduction of an on-device operation cache that can store and reuse frequently occurring operations. This on-device semantic operation cache is used to handle the most frequently used operations locally – entirely eliminating the need for repeated cloud interactions and thus eliminate latency, privacy, and cost concerns for these common operations.
paragraphs.zh: 本文从传统的缓存机制中汲取灵感——这些机制已被证明是提升具有此类特征的工作负载性能并降低成本的极为有效的策略，提出引入一种设备端操作缓存，用于存储和重用频繁出现的操作。 这种设备端语义操作缓存用于本地处理最频繁使用的操作——完全无需重复与云端交互，从而消除了这些常见操作在延迟、隐私和成本方面的担忧。

paragraphs.en: A critical difference from simple domains and standard cache implementation, where the elements in the cache are constant values and matching is simply equality, is that in our setting the cache elements are parameterized operation idioms and the context and NL inputs will not exactly match these existing symbolic cache values. Thus the key insight in our approach is the use of a semantic matcher that can classify parameterized operation idioms based on context and natural language input. This semantic matcher , will be used to perform a combination of classification (cache lookup) to identify the most relevant cached operation idiom for a given NL input and table context. It will then extract and synthesize the final operation or formula by filling in the parameters of the matched operation idiom based on the specific context and NL input.
paragraphs.zh: 与简单领域和标准缓存实现存在一个关键区别：在后者中，缓存中的元素是固定值，匹配也仅仅是基于相等性；而在我们的设定中，缓存元素是参数化的操作习语，且上下文和自然语言输入不会与这些现有的符号化缓存值完全匹配。 因此，我们方法的关键洞察在于使用一种语义匹配器，该匹配器能够根据上下文和自然语言输入对参数化的操作习语进行分类。 这种语义匹配器将用于执行分类（缓存查找）的组合操作，以针对给定的自然语言输入和表格上下文识别出最相关的缓存操作习语。 随后，它将根据具体的上下文和自然语言输入，通过填充匹配到的操作习语中的参数，提取并合成最终的操作或公式。

paragraphs.en: This combination of an on-device operation cache and a semantic matcher allows for efficient handling of recurring operations, significantly reducing latency, cost, and privacy concerns, while passing complex or unusual operations to the cloud when necessary, thus maintaining high accuracy in interpreting natural language queries. paragraphs.en: Using the insight that, for major classes of common tasks, “generation is nearly classification” and can be efficiently approximated by classification + light synthesis, we introduce on-device semantic operation caches for efficiently handling frequently occurring application operations.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这样一个洞见：对于常见任务的主要类别而言，“生成几乎等同于分类”，并且可以通过“分类 + 轻度合成”的方式高效近似，我们引入了设备端语义操作缓存，以高效处理频繁出现的应用程序操作。

paragraphs.en: We present a mechanism for constructing a semantic matcher that can be run on consumer hardware, provides an economically impactful hit (coverage) rate, and do so without compromising result accuracy ( Section 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种构建语义匹配器的机制，该机制可在消费级硬件上运行，提供具有经济影响力的命中（覆盖）率，且不会牺牲结果的准确性（第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We provide a fully automated method for constructing and maintaining the on-device semantic operation cache based entirely on observed usage patterns ( Section 3 and Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了一种完全自动化的方法，用于构建和维护设备端语义操作缓存，该方法完全基于观察到的使用模式（第 3 节和第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of the on-device semantic operation cache in the high-value domain of generating Excel spreadsheet formulas from natural language queries ( Section 4 ) – achieving a hit rate of approximately 55% while maintaining a (correctness) rate of over 96 % 96\% , which translates into a 56 % 56\% reduction in inference costs and a 5 × 5\times speedup in query response time (when cache hits occur).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个高价值领域（从自然语言查询生成 Excel 电子表格公式，见第 4 节）中展示了设备端语义操作缓存的有效性——在保持超过 96%（正确率）的同时，实现了约 55% 的命中率，这相当于将推理成本降低了 56%，并在缓存命中的情况下将查询响应时间提升了 5 倍。

paragraphs.en: This section provides an overview of how the proposed on-device operation caches interact with agentic natural language integration in a software application. For the purposes of this paper we focus on Microsoft Excel spreadsheets as an exemplar of this type of interface as, given the ubiquity, power, and semi-technical abilities of the user-base, it is a prime use case for agent augmented natural language interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 本节概述了所提出的设备端操作缓存如何在软件应用程序中与智能体自然语言集成进行交互。 在本文中，我们以 Microsoft Excel 电子表格作为此类接口的典型示例，因为鉴于其广泛普及、功能强大以及用户群体具备的半技术能力，它成为智能体增强型自然语言交互的理想应用场景。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 illustrates the interaction between the on-device operation caches and agentic natural language support in a spreadsheet. In the standard workflow with the spreadsheet a user can ask a question or issue a command in natural language. This NL input, along with meta-data about the sheet context, is sent to a cloud based agent for processing and response generation. Once the response is generated, it is sent back to the spreadsheet application, which then updates the user interface accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了设备端操作缓存与电子表格中的智能体自然语言支持之间的交互。 在标准的电子表格工作流程中，用户可以以自然语言提出问题或发出指令。 该自然语言输入连同关于电子表格上下文的原数据，会被发送到基于云的智能体进行处理和响应生成。 响应生成后，会发送回电子表格应用程序，随后应用程序会相应地更新用户界面。

paragraphs.en: In our example this natural language might be the command “Which item sold best in June” within the context of a sales spreadsheet that has the months as columns and items, along with sales figures, as the entries. Modern LLM-powered agents have little trouble with a query of this nature, and in practice, respond with an (Excel) formula that when run on the users sheet will select the corresponding row – INDEX(Sales[Item], MATCH(MAX(Sales[July]), Sales[July], 0)) .
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的例子中，这种自然语言可能是“六月哪项商品销量最好”这一指令，其背景是一个销售电子表格，其中月份作为列，商品和销售额数据作为行项。 现代基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体几乎可以轻松处理这类查询，实际上，它们会返回一个（Excel）公式，当在用户的电子表格中运行时，该公式将选中对应的行——INDEX(Sales[Item], MATCH(MAX(Sales[July]), Sales[July], 0))。

paragraphs.en: The detailed architecture of the cache mechanism is shown in Figure 2 . The on-device cache acts as an intermediary between the user interface and the cloud-based AI model processing layer. Given a set of the k k -most frequently occurring operation idioms ( Gulwani and Marron, 2014 ; Allamanis and Sutton, 2014 ; Allamanis et al., 2018 ) the cache will take a users NL input along with any table metadata, such as column names, row counts, data types, and sample data elements, and from these either generate the appropriate specialized formula (based on the cache) or report a miss. In the case of a cache miss, the system will fall back to cloud-based processing to handle the operation, ensuring that all user requests can be fulfilled even if they are not part of the frequently occurring set.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存机制的详细架构如图 2 所示。 设备端缓存在用户界面与云端 AI 模型处理层之间充当中介。 给定一组 k 个最常出现的操作习语（Gulwani and Marron, 2014；Allamanis and Sutton, 2014；Allamanis et al., 2018），缓存将接收用户的自然语言输入以及任何表格元数据，例如列名、行数、数据类型和样本数据元素，并据此生成相应的专用公式（基于缓存）或报告缓存未命中。 如果发生缓存未命中，系统将转而使用云端处理来执行该操作，从而确保所有用户请求都能得到满足，即使这些请求不属于最常出现的集合。

paragraphs.en: After the clustering process we are ready to begin training the semantic mapper. At this point we need to make a key parametric decision in the system design. Specifically selecting the target cache-hit rate. This decision will influence the trade-off between the effectiveness of the cache and the eventual ability to ensure high precision. In the training we must select the number of idioms F i F_{i} to be used as labels in the cache. paragraphs.en: The final cache-hit decision is then based on both 1) the model’s refusal gate and 2) the confidence gate. Specifically, a cache hit occurs only if the model produces a formula and the confidence exceeds the threshold; otherwise, the query is routed to the fallback model.

paragraphs.en: The refusal gate captures queries the model knows are out-of-head; the confidence gate additionally catches in-head queries where the particular generation is unreliable. Validation loss is evaluated every 300 300 steps with a patience of 3 3 evaluations, and the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss is kept. The training data for this process is a special hold-out subset of the NL2Formula dataset which is not used in any other part of the experiments. All finetune runs were performed on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU and took a maximum of 6 6 hours.

paragraphs.en: The primary metrics we evaluate are the ability of the cache to correctly serve queries, measured in terms of hit rate and precision, and secondarily, the overall impact this has on latency and inference costs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估的主要指标是缓存正确响应查询的能力，具体通过命中率与精确度来衡量；次要指标则是这一机制对延迟和推理成本的总体影响。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate these features, we compare a baseline Excel agent where every request is handled in the cloud using GPT-5, with model routing enabled, against our proposed approach where a local cache with Gemma 3 1B is used first, and only queries with low confidence are passed to the cloud.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估这些功能，我们将一个基准 Excel 智能体（其中每个请求都通过云端 GPT-5 处理，并启用了模型路由）与我们提出的方法进行了比较：在提出方法中，首先使用本地缓存中的 Gemma 3 1B，只有置信度较低的问题才会被发送到云端。

paragraphs.en: The results in Table 1 demonstrate that using a local cache with cloud fall back significantly reduces both latency and inference costs while maintaining a high hit rate. As shown in the Hit Rate row, the local cache is able to serve a substantial fraction of queries, while still maintaining over a 95 % 95\% correctness rate, thus reducing the number of requests that are processed remotely. This directly translates into substantial reductions in inference costs, reducing them by 56 % 56\% , and on cache hits, bringing the time to serve a query down to just 0.31 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 中的结果表明，使用本地缓存并辅以云端回退方案，可以在保持高命中率的同时显著降低延迟和推理成本。 如“命中率”行所示，本地缓存能够处理相当大比例的查询，同时仍能保持超过 95% 的正确率，从而减少了远程处理的请求数量。 这直接带来了推理成本的显著下降，降幅达到 56%，而在缓存命中的情况下，查询响应时间缩短至仅 0.31 秒。

paragraphs.en: As Table 2 shows, the untuned local models are almost completely ineffective on tasks with the complexity of generating Excel formulas. paragraphs.en: To evaluate the robustness of the cache to noisy inputs, we perturb the natural-language queries with keyboard-typo noise using the nlpaug library ( Ma, 2019 ) . paragraphs.en: A key consideration in the design of the cache mechanism, and training setup, presented in this work is enable automation of both an initial training corpus and online (incremental) retraining of the cache based on new user interactions. In addition to these baseline capabilities, the system is also designed to support specialization for individual teams or organizations by allowing the cache to adapt to particular usage patterns, vocabularies, operation sets, and preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究中提出的缓存机制设计和训练设置的一个关键考量是，实现初始训练语料和基于新用户交互的在线（增量）缓存重训练的自动化。 除了这些基础能力之外，该系统还被设计为支持针对特定团队或组织的专门化，通过让缓存能够适应特定的使用模式、词汇表、操作集和偏好。

sents.en: In addition to these baseline capabilities, the system is also designed to support specialization for individual teams or organizations by allowing the cache to adapt to particular usage patterns, vocabularies, operation sets, and preferences.

paragraphs.en: As described in Section 3 , the required input data for training the cache are triples of the form ( q i , c i , o i ) (q_{i},c_{i},o_{i}) , where q i q_{i} represents the user query, c i c_{i} represents the context or conditions under which the query is made, and o i o_{i} represents the corresponding operation or output generated by the system. As such these training values are exactly what the system inputs and, cloud based agent, outputs are during normal (cache unassisted operation). Thus, the initial training corpus can be directly constructed from these interactions, ensuring that the cache is trained on realistic and representative examples from the outset.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 3 节所述，训练缓存所需的输入数据是形如 (q_i, c_i, o_i) 的三元组，其中 q_i 表示用户查询，c_i 表示提出该查询时的上下文或条件，而 o_i 表示系统生成的相应操作或输出。 因此，这些训练值正是系统在正常运行（即缓存未辅助操作）期间输入和输出的内容。 因此，初始训练语料可以直接从这些交互中构建，从而确保缓存从一开始就基于真实且具有代表性的示例进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Further as shown in the evaluations ( Section 4 ), an performant cache can be constructed from a relatively modest initial training corpus, 55 ​ k 55k examples for the NL2Formula dataset, and then trained using an entry-level ML workstation, highlighting the efficiency of the proposed approach.

paragraphs.en: Beyond simply producing a general-purpose cache, the system is designed to support specialization for individual teams or organizations. This allows the cache to adapt to particular usage patterns, vocabularies, operation sets, and preferences, thereby improving its effectiveness and relevance in specific contexts. Given the ability to automatically build a training dataset and quickly re-build the cache model, it becomes feasible to maintain a specialized and up-to-date cache that continuously adapts to the evolving needs and behaviors of specific teams or organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统的设计不仅限于生成通用缓存，还支持为各个团队或组织进行专门定制。 这使得缓存能够适应特定的使用模式、词汇表、操作集和偏好，从而在特定情境中提升其有效性和相关性。 鉴于系统具备自动构建训练数据集并快速重建缓存模型的能力，因此可以维护一个专业且最新的缓存，使其持续适应特定团队或组织不断变化的需求与行为。

paragraphs.en: The dream of providing natural language interfaces to applications, and spreadsheets in particular, has been a long-standing topic of research. Early work on semantic parsing for natural language to formula translation focused on using statistical machine translation techniques ( Wong and Mooney, 2006 ) and structural program synthesis approaches ( Gulwani and Marron, 2014 ) . The advent of large language models provided a new means for approaching the problem and has been explored in recent works ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2023 ; Shuai et al., 2026a ) that demonstrate the effectiveness of large language models in translating natural language to formulas on spreadsheets.
paragraphs.zh: 为应用程序（尤其是电子表格）提供自然语言接口的梦想，长期以来一直是研究的一个主题。 早期关于自然语言到公式转换的语义解析工作，主要集中在使用统计机器翻译技术（Wong 和 Mooney，2006）以及结构化程序合成方法（Gulwani 和 Marron，2014）。 大型语言模型的出现为这一问题提供了新的解决途径，近期的研究（Zhao 等人，2024；He 等人，2023；Shuai 等人，2026a）也对此进行了探索，这些研究证明了大型语言模型在将自然语言转换为电子表格公式方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: The cost of running a frontier scale LLM for every user query has been studied from a number of directions. The most general is the development of routing ( Ong et al., 2024 ) and caching strategies that aim to minimize redundant computations ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Bang, 2023 ) and optimize resource usage. These general techniques are designed to work accross a wide range of (perhaps dynamically varying) sets of LLM promts.
paragraphs.zh: 针对每条用户查询运行前沿规模大语言模型的成本，已从多个角度进行了研究。 最普遍的方法包括开发路由（Ong 等人，2024）和缓存策略，旨在减少冗余计算（Chen 等人，2023；Bang，2023）并优化资源使用。 这些通用技术旨在适用于各种（可能动态变化的）大语言模型提示集。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has investigated the possibility of local models and caching strategies to reduce the reliance on large-scale LLMs for every query. This includes approaches such as ( Bang, 2023 ; Gill et al., 2025 ; Schroeder et al., 2026 ) , which leverage local caching mechanisms based on semantic embbeddings and similarity search, or fine-tuning based on a known set of prompts ( Shuai et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究探讨了使用本地模型和缓存策略的可能性，以减少每次查询对大规模 LLM 的依赖。 这包括诸如（Bang, 2023；Gill 等人, 2025；Schroeder 等人, 2026）等方法，这些方法利用基于语义嵌入和相似性搜索的本地缓存机制，或基于已知提示词集进行微调（Shuai 等人, 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: The two most closely related approache is the work of Chakraborty et.al. ( Chakraborty et al., 2025 ) which, similar to the work in this paper, explore the use of local caching mechanisms that map from natural language queries to a template for generating the corresponding result. In ( Chakraborty et al., 2025 ) , the system generates a program that, when run, will compute the literal result corresponding to the query and associates it with a regular expression pattern. When a new query matches the regex, the cached program is executed to produce the result. As a result this system is highly effective for simple datasets where the natural language variability and presence of noise is limited.

paragraphs.en: Using a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches . These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring actions completely on-device.
